description: This file contains Swift unit tests for the GatewayConnectionSecurity component of a network application. It defines test cases for TLS fingerprint handling, auto-connection logic, and manual TLS usage rules involving gateweays and network hosts.

methods.name: makeController
methods.description: Creates an instance of GatewayConnectionController with a fresh NodeAppModel, configured for tests.

methods.name: makeDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Constructs a simulated DiscoveredGateway object with specified parameters for testing.

methods.name: clearTLSFingerprint
methods.description: Clears the stored TLS fingerprint for a given stableID.

methods.name: _test_resolveDiscoveredTLSParams
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters based on discovered gateway info, allowing testing of fingerprint preferences.

methods.name: _test_setGateways
methods.description: Sets the internal gateway list in the controller for testing.

methods.name: _test_triggerAutoConnect
methods.description: Simulates an auto-connect trigger within the controller for testing.

methods.name: _test_didAutoConnect
methods.description: Checks if the controller auto-connected during the test.

methods.name: _test_resolveManualUseTLS
methods.description: Determines whether manual host should use TLS based on hostname rules.

methods.name: _test_resolveManualPort
methods.description: Decides the port to use for manual host connections based on host and TLS usage.
